limitations: The 14 village-level DILRMP rows in dilrmp_real_snapshot.json are a historical source-derived subset for Karnataka and West Bengal only (July/August 2024); they are not a 36-State village census.
ABDB includes disputed/unassigned and incomplete attributes; the project records rather than fills these gaps.
NGDRS live IGR integration has 26 reporting jurisdictions; 10 rows are explicitly marked not reported in this snapshot. A separate manual data-entry table is not merged into the live IGR feed.

NGDRS manual data-entry form rows for Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, Sikkim, Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh are stored in a separate historical snapshot; not merged with current 26 live IGR rows or the national live-feed total.
LACRRIS project-area totals do not identify universal parcel IDs; parcel acquisition status must remain UNKNOWN until an official parcel-matched record is present.
The parcel and acquisition-case evidence stores are intentionally empty until a lawful source record is imported with provenance.

LACRRIS national dashboard values are national aggregates; the public State/UT report requires a state selection. The package therefore stores null state-specific figures until a selected report or authorised export is ingested.
Official acquisition notice catalogues for Maharashtra, Odisha and Puducherry are indexed as source references; missing numeric fields were not inferred from titles.
Meghalaya government describes the absence of a uniform State-wide RoR and a role for Autonomous District Councils; local records require competent authority-level verification.
Legacy DILRMP MIS 3.0 map/ULPIN metrics are not comparable to current MIS 4.0 and are kept separately. Only the West Bengal district grand total was fully captured from the legacy page in this build.
No public nationwide owner-by-owner bulk dataset or open bulk-owner API was established.
RBIH Next-Gen LRS supports 12 State backends for authorised single-parcel queries; a separate v3 guide documents 14 State lender integrations. No RBIH credentials or consent artefacts are bundled.
DILRMP 3.0 uses federated State/UT data custody. It does not make all source records an openly downloadable national owner list.
A matched RoR holder/parcel entry is source-record evidence, not a conclusive legal title adjudication.

India Property Register is an independent commercial provider, not a government endpoint. Its documented 28/36 plot coverage and record counts are provider claims; live coverage, record freshness, and each underlying government source must be checked. This build makes single parcel lookups only, does not bulk-import its data and does not use it for AI model training/evaluation.
